newsitem.title: HUNGARY: OLYMPIC AIRWAYS TO START FLIGHTS TO BUDAPEST.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPIC AIRWAYS TO START FLIGHTS TO BUDAPEST.

text.p: Greek state-owned airline Olympic Airways plans to operate scheduled flights non-stop to Budapest from Athens five times a week on Boeing B737-200 airplanes from June 22 to October 25, the Hungarian Airport Coordination Service (ACS) said on Wednesday.

Flights will arrive at Budapest Ferihegy Airport from Athens Hellenikon Airport at 1250 GMT and depart for Athens at 1340 GMT on Tuesdays, Thursdays, Saturdays and Sundays, said Helen Guraly, ACS's general airport coordinator.
On Mondays, the airplanes will land in Budapest at 1720 GMT and leave for Athens at 1810 GMT, Guraly told Reuters.
The flights, Olympic's first scheduled traffic to Hungary in the 1990s, will mainly serve business and tourism passengers, but the airplanes will offer space to carry cargo.
